contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)
D N IVSTINI-ANVS P P AVC ; VICTORI-A AVCCC H

A gold early-medieval coin pendant utilising an imitation of a gold Byzantine solidus of Justinian I (527-565), 'VICTORI-A AVCCC H' with officina letter reverse type, angel standing facing, holding jewelled cross and cross on globe; star in right field; *//CONOB.
